name: Zoho Desk
description: Zoho Desk is an AI-powered customer service platform that unifies support conversations across channels into one inbox, with a Zia AI assistant that handles routine tickets autonomously.
best_for: Customer-first businesses of all sizes — Zoho reports 125,000+ organizations globally — wanting unified multichannel ticketing with AI automation.
features: Unified inbox consolidating support conversations across channels
24/7 branded self-service help center with knowledge base and community
Zia AI assistant that autonomously resolves routine tickets
Skill- and workload-based automated ticket routing
Shared ticket ownership and internal team collaboration notes
Real-time analytics dashboards for CSAT and performance tracking

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Up to 3 agents; free forever. Email ticketing out of the box.

tiers.name: Express
tiers.notes: Email, social media, web forms, AI agents, and workflows ($9/user/mo billed monthly).

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Adds business messaging, answer bot, community forum, and knowledge base ($20/user/mo billed monthly).

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Adds telephony, Zia AI, blueprints, multi-department, and round-robin assignment ($35/user/mo billed monthly).

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Adds live chat, guided conversations, skill-based assignment, and sandbox ($50/user/mo billed monthly).

alternatives.name: Zendesk
alternatives.description: A customer service platform with ticketing, live chat, and AI-powered automation.
alternatives.best_for: Support teams of all sizes needing an established, feature-rich helpdesk.

alternatives.name: Freshdesk
alternatives.description: A cloud-based help desk with ticketing, automation, and omnichannel support.
alternatives.best_for: Support teams wanting an affordable, easy-to-deploy helpdesk.

alternatives.name: Help Scout
alternatives.description: A shared inbox and help desk platform built for personalized, human-feeling support.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized support teams wanting simple, email-centric ticketing.
